cards.name: Fire Bolt
cards.effect: Ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d10 fire damage.
cards.fluff: A mote of fire flickers to life between my fingers before I hurl it.
cards.tactic: Reliable single-target damage cantrip, usable at will.

cards.name: Shield
cards.effect: +5 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack.
cards.fluff: An unseen force deflects the incoming blow just in time.
cards.tactic: Use when a single big hit would otherwise land.

cards.name: Cure Wounds
cards.effect: A creature you touch regains 1d8 + spellcasting modifier hit points.
cards.fluff: Warm light flows from my hand into the wound.
cards.tactic: Stabilize an ally who dropped low without spending a bonus action.

cards.name: Resources
cards.fluff: Even the mightiest magic needs rest to recover.
